prompt: How do we scope our environment for CMMC Level 2? We want an enclave approach.
assertions: Uses the CMMC scoping categories: CUI assets, Security Protection Assets, Contractor Risk Managed Assets, Specialized Assets, and out-of-scope assets — with the required treatment of each
Endorses the enclave strategy: concentrate CUI processing/storage/transmission into a bounded environment to shrink the assessment boundary
Requires dataflow mapping: where CUI enters, moves, is stored, and exits (email, file shares, endpoints, cloud)
Covers external service providers: CSPs handling CUI need FedRAMP Moderate (or equivalency); ESPs/MSPs are in scope via Security Protection Asset treatment
Covers flow-down: subcontractors receiving CUI need Level 2; FCI-only subs need Level 1 — with the DFARS 7012 clause flowing down
